protocol_outcome.reason: The preregistered v2 protocol defines any target-concept REPRESENTATION_GAP as repeatability not proven. ReAssure 3.0 exposed one waiting-period gap and two related copayment representation/certification gaps while all primary anti-gaming metrics remained zero.

architecture_interpretation.finding: The Health foundation is not invalidated. Product5 identified bounded semantic/certification extensions that could not have been justified safely before real evidence exposed them.

post_test_extension_sequence: Add a generic underwriting/personal condition-specific waiting-period representation that preserves insured-person scope, affected-condition dependency, up-to duration semantics, and policy/Schedule/underwriting resolution without manufacturing a product-wide scalar.
Add generic copayment composition semantics that preserve additional/cumulative behavior as a first-class mechanic rather than flattening it into an ordinary percentage.

Extend generic conditional-copayment certification to support multispan/component-level evidence attribution so a rate matrix and its separate calculation-basis/trigger clause can be certified together.
Re-run ReAssure 3.0 after those extensions as post-gap validation; do not retroactively change the product5 initial result.
If formal manufacturing repeatability is still required before Motor, run a new neutral Health cold-start after the earned extensions are merged and frozen.
